s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive lower extremity weakness and pain with foot drop
key_facts: 48-year-old woman with a history of asthma
2-day history of right lower-extremity numbness and pain
No low back pain
Manual muscle testing of the right tibialis anterior and extensor hallucis longus was 3/5
Gastrocnemius and flexor hallucis longus were 4/5
Deep-tendon reflexes were normal
Straight-leg-raising was positive at 70 degrees
Femoral-nerve stretch test was negative
Degenerative scoliosis at L5-S1 on plain radiographs
Right-sided disc herniation at L5-S1 on lumbar MRI
No significant nerve-root or cord compression on lumbar MRI
Motor conduction velocity of 51.5 m/s on peroneal-nerve conduction studies
Ankle-brachial indices were decreased (0.78 on the right, 0.73 on the left)
Lower-extremity arteriography showed no significant vascular lesions

shortlist.label: Vasculitic neuropathy
shortlist.why_kept: Decreased ankle-brachial indices and progressive lower extremity weakness

shortlist.label: Lumbosacral plexopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive lower extremity weakness and pain with foot drop

shortlist.label: Chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyneuropathy
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive lower extremity weakness and abnormal peroneal-nerve conduction studies

shortlist.label: Peroneal nerve palsy
shortlist.why_kept: Foot drop and conduction changes on peroneal-nerve conduction studies

shortlist.label: Polyarteritis nodosa
shortlist.why_kept: Systemic symptoms and decreased ankle-brachial indices

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms of right lower-extremity numbness and pain, foot drop, and conduction changes on peroneal-nerve conduction studies are consistent with peroneal nerve palsy. The absence of significant nerve-root or cord compression on lumbar MRI and the negative femoral-nerve stretch test also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Vasculitic neuropathy
rejected.why: There is no clear evidence of vasculitis in the patient's history or laboratory results.

rejected.label: Lumbosacral plexopathy
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms are more localized to the peroneal nerve distribution, and there is no evidence of more widespread plexus involvement.

rejected.label: Chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyneuropathy
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms are more acute and localized, and there is no evidence of a more widespread demyelinating process.

rejected.label: Polyarteritis nodosa
rejected.why: There is no clear evidence of systemic vasculitis or other organ involvement typical of polyarteritis nodosa.
